newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - BWAY FY97 EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BWAY FY97 EPS view cut.

text.p: --Mesirow Financial said Wednesday it reduced its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate on BWAY Corp to $1.90 a share from $2.35, noting that the company's acquisition of Ball Corp's aerosol can business will hurt earnings growth for the year ending June 30, 1997.
--It said the acquisition will position BWAY for rapid earnings gains in fiscal 1998, for which Mesirow has initiated an estimate of $2.55 a share.
--"We are maintaining our focus buy recommendation on BWAY with an 18-month price target range of $30 to $32 per share," said analyst Gary Prestopino.
